paragraphs.text:
A man charges a few piastres to go in, taking change from a cigar 
box. Above him, in five languages, a sign says: “A Tomb of the 
Court of Amenhotep IV (Akhenaten).”
To enter the pyramid, you pay the entrance fee and go to 338. 
To explore the outside of the pyramid, go to 360. Or you can 
return to the village, go to 324.
(324, 339, 344, 390)
